A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same BAM research work, with 29 complete pages including Appendices A–K. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original model evaluations, including passkey retrieval, perplexity, downstream benchmarks, ablations, and inference timing in Section 3 and Appendices D–H.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including retrieval plots and the benchmark and timing results in Tables 2–8.

M1.justification: The BAM procedure, GGD prior, learned parameters, and SSMax combination are unchanged. Figure 2’s sign correction matches the negative positional bias already specified in Section 2.3 and Appendix C.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FineWeb and Wikipedia data, passkey retrieval scenarios, RULER tasks, MMLU, ARC, and LongBenchV2 evaluations. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: Sinusoidal, NoPE, RoPE, Local RoPE, ALiBi, and their evaluated SSMax variants. The larger-model BAM-versus-RoPE comparisons are also retained.

E3.justification: Model configurations, training contexts, evaluation procedures, and sample counts are unchanged. Appendix H.5 retains the same context extension procedure of 256 steps at length 1024; Figure 17’s caption edit introduces no new setting.

E4.justification: The attention analyses and Appendix H studies of initialization, learned parameters, training context, SSMax, context extension, model size, and inference performance are unchanged. Figure 17 retains the same context extension analysis and curves.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the 100-sample timing experiment and standard deviations in Table 8. No seed information, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or statistical testing practices are added or revised.

E6.justification: All empirical tables and plots retain their numerical values, curves, and reported findings. Removing '1B' from Figure 17’s caption does not alter its existing results for three model scales.

T1.justification: The definitions, theorems, lemmas, and derivations in Section 2 and Appendices A, B, and K are unchanged. Figure 2 corrects an illustrative sign to agree with the existing equations, without revising mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about probabilistic positional priors, unifying existing encodings, and improved long-context retrieval with minimal additional parameters.

C2.justification: Interpretations of learned priors, attention fading, retrieval performance, and context extension are unchanged. Appendix I retains the same limitations concerning model scale, datasets, comparator coverage, and instruction or preference tuning.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains the same architecture, optimizer, learning rates, training budget, hardware, bias parameterization, and numerical stabilization details. Code access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The references and related-work discussion are unchanged, including positioning relative to NoPE, ALiBi, RoPE, T5 relative bias, and SSMax.

P1.justification: Figure 17’s caption removes '1B', and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, headings, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 replaces '+' with '−' before the positional penalty. Figure 17’s caption drops '1B' to match its existing 120M, 432M, and 1.1B curves. Other figures, tables, and page layouts are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects Figure 2’s misleading sign to agree with the established negative bias and makes Figure 17’s caption accurately cover its three plotted model scales. These provide limited improvements in technical presentation accuracy; the scientific content and supporting evidence remain unchanged.
